title: Completed diagonal class and traces commute with pullback
statement: Let ell and p be distinct primes, k a field of characteristic p, and Y and Yprime Noetherian separated finite-type k-schemes whose projective lines and their self-products are Noetherian, as in [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let g:Yprime→Y be a separated finite-type k-morphism, and suppose ell is a unit in the global sections of each base. Fix DiagonalTraceLocalizations on each base, its projective line and its self-product. Fix the two derived reductions D and Dprime, their CompletionSpec and CycleSystemSpec, and two completed diagonal arrows delta and deltaprime satisfying the whole-system IsDiagonalLimit characterization [det-prop-diagonal-tower-limit, det-prop-diagonal-tower-trace]. Fix coefficient Families and Reference data for these arrows as in [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-reference], and the three BaseSquares of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-source-pullback]. Then the Z_ell members have PullbackCompatibility of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-pullback], using the fixed spIntegralComparison at the bottom finite field on the projective line and its self-product. This asserts the ordinary normalized supported-source isomorphism, the completed class square, and all three trace squares with their canonical invertible base-change mates. It makes no assertion at other coefficient stages.

proof.text: Apply the completed-class pullback lemma to the two IsDiagonalLimit witnesses and the source-normalized P/W realizations extracted from the References. Rewrite the two realized arrows by Reference.delta. This supplies SourcePullback and the delta field of PullbackCompatibility.

The projective-line base square is ProjectiveSpace.isPullback_map. Paste it with the chosen product pullbacks, once in each factor order, to prove the two projection squares are Cartesian. Map the base units along the structure morphisms to obtain the units on the projective lines.

Apply the same completed-trace pullback lemma three times, to q, p1 and p2, using the Reference completed push squares and the diagrams canonical derived functors and their full universal units. Cancel the two invertible realization factors in each CompletedTraceCompatibility equation to identify the displayed trace formulas with the family traces. Assemble the class square and the three trace squares into PullbackCompatibility.

proof_origin.note: Lean assembly of the class square and three applications of a single projective-line trace lemma; the two strictly narrower whole-system obligations remain open in new modules.

mathlib_searches.query: Base change for completed diagonal cycle class and projective line trace, followed by integral and rational scalar extension
mathlib_searches.results: Eight results, including LinearMap.trace_baseChange and elliptic-curve baseChange_add lemmas; none concerns the diagonal cycle class, derived trace, or normalized condensed coefficient pullback. Local searches found only the existing compatibility structures and their unproved assembly.
The query returned general categorical naturality results, including pushout cocone and Grothendieck-map formulas. These do not supply geometric system or scalar-extension comparison coherence.
mathlib_searches.verdict: General naturality is available; no complete compatibility theorem.

mathlib_searches.results: Three Mathlib hits, all in CategoryTheory/MorphismProperty/Limits.lean concerning stability of diagonals under base change. Local rg on both library roots found the definitions of PullbackCompatibility and NonTorsionPullback and the original unfinished theorem, but no proof of either required compatibility.
mathlib_searches.verdict: No existing completed or scalar diagonal compatibility theorem.

theorem diagonalCoefficient_completedPullback (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p] (_hpl : p ≠ l)
    (Y Y' : Scheme.{u}) [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y'.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y' ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y' ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Y' ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)] [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y)]
    [IsNoetherian Y'] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y')] [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y')]
    (g : Y' ⟶ Y) [g.IsOver (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType g] [QuasiCompact g] [IsSeparated g]
    (hY : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y, ⊤))) (hY' : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y', ⊤)))
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l Y]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l Y']
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y')]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y')]
    (D : DiagonalDerivedReduction l (diagonalScalarExtension l (diagonalSurface Y)))
    (_hcompletion : DiagonalCompletionSpec l (diagonalSurface Y) D)
    (_hsystem : DiagonalCycleSystemSpec l Y hY D)
    (D' : DiagonalDerivedReduction l (diagonalScalarExtension l (diagonalSurface Y')))
    (_hcompletion' : DiagonalCompletionSpec l (diagonalSurface Y') D')
    (_hsystem' : DiagonalCycleSystemSpec l Y' hY' D')
    (δ : diagonalCompletedDomain l Y ⟶ diagonalCompletedCodomain l Y)
    (δ' : diagonalCompletedDomain l Y' ⟶ diagonalCompletedCodomain l Y')
    (_hδ : DiagonalTrace.IsDiagonalLimit l Y hY D δ)
    (_hδ' : DiagonalTrace.IsDiagonalLimit l Y' hY' D' δ')
    (geometry : BaseSquares g)
    (family : Family l Y) (family' : Family l Y')
    (_reference : Reference l Y δ family) (_reference' : Reference l Y' δ' family') :
    Nonempty (PullbackCompatibility (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} ℤ_[l]) g
      (zlLine l) family.zl family'.zl
      (spIntegralComparison (baseP g) l (bottomField l))
      (spIntegralComparison (baseW g) l (bottomField l)))
